summary: Validated PDF/Excel/CSV export from /reports by driving Playwright (mobile viewport), capturing downloads, and parsing files with pdfplumber/openpyxl. All export flows work correctly and match backend ground truth. NOTE: Task assumed 64 active chandas but backend currently has 66 active (44 Pending + 22 Collected). All 3 exports correctly export 66 rows on default filters and 44 rows on Status=Pending filter. Known donor values (samshad ali 1500 Pending, Kundan Bhai 5051 Collected, brijesh kahar 500 Pending receipt#99) all verified in both PDF and XLSX outputs. Column picker works (unchecking Amount+Date yields 4-column xlsx). Mobile header-reports-btn-mobile is visible on Dashboard/Chanda/Members/Settings and navigates to /reports. WhatsApp share falls back to download+wa.me correctly.
action_items: Informational: Task briefed 64 active chandas but backend truth is 66 (44 Pending + 22 Collected per GET /api/dashboard). Exports correctly match backend, so no bug to fix — just heads-up that the '38 + 26 = 64' seed assumption is stale (2 extra records exist).

Optional enhancement: PDF autoTable wraps long header/cell text (e.g. 'Payment Mode' becomes 'Payment\nMode'; 'Roahan Chaurasiya Panawala' wraps). This is cosmetic — increase column width or nowrap for header row if visually undesirable.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx amount cell in xlsx correctly uses raw number (good for aggregation) — validated numeric type in openpyxl.
PDF uses 'Rs.' prefix as documented (jsPDF Helvetica cannot render ₹). Working as designed.
shareWhatsApp fallback path triggers doc.save() successfully when navigator.canShare files unsupported — verified in headless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reports export functionality fully validated. Parser script at /app/test_reports/parse_exports.py can be re-run any time — it fetches live ground truth from /api/chanda then compares against downloaded files. Two 'failures' printed by the script are false positives caused by pdfplumber inserting \n on cell text-wrap (header 'Payment Mode' cell and long donor name 'Roahan Chaurasiya Panawala'); actual PDF content is correct.
